from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class InstitutionMetrics(BaseModel):
    """Extraction from one institution's CDS report."""
    institution_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university/college")
    total_undergraduate_population: int | None = Field(description="Total undergraduate enrollment")
    nonresident_alien_count: int | None = Field(description="Number of nonresident alien undergraduates")
    nonresident_alien_percentage: float | None = Field(description="Percentage of undergraduates who are nonresident aliens")
    graduation_rate_2015_cohort: float | None = Field(description="Six-year graduation rate for Fall 2015 cohort")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    institution_metrics: list[InstitutionMetrics]
